What Types of Employers Are Out There?

  • Support activities for forestry
  • Public administration, mostly at the municipal level
  • Electric power generation, transmission and distribution


What are the Main Trends Affecting Employment?

  • Ongoing tariffs and other challenges in the forestry sector are expected to negatively affect job prospects
  • Public-sector investments in forestry should support the industry over the longer term


What Skills Do I Need to Succeed?

  • To work in professional forestry, individuals must be a Registered Professional Forester (R.P.F) and obtain full membership status with the regulatory body, the Ontario Professional Foresters Association (OPFA)
  • Limited work may be performed as an Associate member of the OPFA


What Other Information Will I Find Helpful?

  • Economic activity in the forestry sector is concentrated in northern Ontario.

Employment in forestry-related professions has been declining year-over-year, and the industry faces several curtailments at wood manufacturing facilities. 

Stable job growth continues to be inhibited by difficulty accessing economic fibre, falling annual harvests, high U.S. duties and tariffs, and the impacts of extreme weather and wildfires, though the industry remains particularly important to rural and Indigenous communities. 

Provincial and federal funding for reforestation projects as well as support for wood manufacturing and mass timber may provide some employment opportunities.

Des difficultés continuent d’entraver la croissance stable des emplois, comme l’accès aux fibres économiques, la diminution des récoltes annuelles, les droits de douane élevés des États-Unis et les répercussions des conditions météorologiques extrêmes et des feux incontrôlés. 

L’industrie demeure toutefois particulièrement importante pour les communautés rurales et autochtones. 

Le financement provincial et fédéral pour les projets de reboisement ainsi que le soutien à la fabrication du bois et au bois massif pourraient offrir des possibilités d’emploi.
